# BES — the behaviour layer

> A stolen key still works; its thief's behaviour doesn't. The BES layer checks every validly signed action against how its holder really behaves — the owner's own baseline, his AI agent's own baseline, and a delegation envelope the owner signed — and steps up or blocks a valid key in the wrong hands. Layer 3 of four: verify-before-parse, the LIGHT barrier, BES, the immune system and tarpit.

- Live page (runs the real kernels on synthetic behaviour, explains itself, carries the brochure and white paper): https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/bes-inward/
- Sealed claims (committed before the measuring code): https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/bes-inward/blob/main/measure/claims.json
- Real-behaviour receipt (counts and rates only): https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/bes-inward/blob/main/receipts/real.json
- Synthetic receipt (CI reproduces it byte for byte): https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/bes-inward/blob/main/receipts/synthetic.json
- Source: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/bes-inward
